results.snippet: See what employees say it's like to work at Klapprodt Pools. Salaries, reviews, and more - all posted by employees working at Klapprodt Pools.

reviews.text: Klapprodt Pools built our pool and has serviced it for 3+ years. As new pool owners we had a lot to learn. Justin is our pool service tech has been there every step of the way.  We appreciate his advice, expertise and patience. Such a great guy! Our dogs look forward to his weekly visits too.
reviews.author: DeLane Jackson

reviews.text: Jayda has been servicing our pool for a little over 2 1/2 years. She is amazing at her job!  She makes sure your pool and spa is up and run all year long. She is at our home each week on time as schedule. If she’s going to be out she notifies me and lets me know who’s going to cover for her.  I appreciate all she does.. 😊😊
reviews.author: Jennifer Bacon

reviews.text: Purchased a new home with a Klapprodt pool remodel. As a new homeowner I wanted some assistance - called them multiple times and left messages, and also sent emails. Not one call back or email response. Maybe the name has reputation and they're too busy, but I'll never try to contact them again.
reviews.author: Bob Xerri

reviews.text: So happy we went with this company. We love our pool and the patience they gave us during the design process was so appreciated! Especially picking the plaster!! Excellent customer service!
reviews.author: Brenda

reviews.text: Such an amazing experience with Klapprodt.  We did our research and asked around there are so many builders in the area but finally went with Klapprodt when we found consistent and honest feedback from folks we knew that built pools with them.  At the same time we built our pool we have several friends put theirs in too and they did not have the same  pleasant experience as we did.  We love our pool and love our customer service manager Travis!
reviews.author: Greg Langford

reviews.text: We’ve been with Klapprodt for over 5 years now and have had nothing but a great experience. Jayda is absolutely wonderful and updates us on anything that is having issues and works to correct it quickly. She’s given us so many great tips and recommendations. Cannot say enough great things about her! After the big freeze, their team was quick to repair our busted pump and pipes. They are always very prompt and professional. Highly recommend for your pool needs.
reviews.author: mary nivens

reviews.text: Best design and build experience ever!  The team was honest, accurate, accountable and on schedule.  Joe Ray is the construction foreman and is involved in every detail of the process - before, during and after construction.  His experience and knowledge are unmatched.  He was on site nearly every day of the construction phase and when I needed something 6 months after installation was complete - he responded the same day and resolved the issue within hours.  I can't say enough positive things about my experience with Joe Ray and the Klapprodt team.
reviews.author: Diana Young

reviews.text: Kladdprodt pool did an awesome job on our design and installation. A huge shout out to Cameron,  Travis and Clint for all the knowledge they shared along the way plus answering all of my questions.  They always responded with any questions or concerns we threw at them.  We will enjoy the pool for many years to come.
reviews.author: Rodney Jacks

data.summary: Reviews for Klapprodt Pools appear highly authentic and reflect a company with strong long-term customer relationships, particularly for pool service and maintenance. The detailed, personal reviews naming specific employees and describing multi-year relationships are credible. The primary complaint pattern involves unresponsiveness to new inquiries (not from existing service customers), which may indicate a prioritization of current clients over new leads. The company demonstrates good follow-through on service and warranty issues for their customer base.
fake_signals: Limited review volume on primary platforms (Google, Houzz) for a 47-year-old company
No negative reviews with specific project details

negative_evidence: Single complaint about unresponsiveness to a new inquiry suggests potential gap in follow-through for non-service customers
positive_evidence: 'came back and fixed the issue at no charge' implied in review #6

authentic_signals: Specific employee names and roles mentioned (Justin, Jayda, Travis, Joe Ray, Cameron, Clint)
Varied writing styles and personal anecdotes
